Who's in it: patient event records recorded as daily census events for individual patients.
Each row shows: event type, timing, patient identity and class, location, service, and census day.
Time window: a configurable start-to-end date window.
Excludes: events scheduled outside the specified date range; events created on or after the as-of cutoff; canceled events deleted before the as-of cutoff; records with no recorded patient identifier; records missing required external selections; records in specific operating room, cath lab, imaging, emergency, or psychiatry locations

This selection contains admission, discharge, and transfer event records categorized as census.  
It includes bed, room, department, service area, patient class, and patient service details.  
It restricts to scheduled events within configured date windows and requires recorded patient identifiers.

This selection contains values produced by splitting a provided service area string by commas.  
Each value is either a zero value or a service area identifier.  
Each row also carries a constant with value one.
